name: 1501, Larkspur Lane, Maryland
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.
Dialogue: Mulder: "You don't believe in ghosts?"Scully: "That surprises you?"

name: A Bit of Light
Text: Play on an Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION Or BEHAVIORAL skill check.
Dialogue: "It's here! Here!" - Frank Briggs

name: A Privileged Mind
Text: Play this card to look at the top three cards of your Bureau deck. Then, you may place them back in any order.
Dialogue: "How you know what your opponent's going to do? You get inside his head. You read his thoughts." - Mulder

name: Adam Pierce
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's SCIENCES or adds 2 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "I wish I could explain. Daniel and I, uh… I always played Salieri to his Mozart. I was never quite on his plane of intellect, but this time I found him slipping into madness, the way he began to control the others."

name: Adversary's Rebirth
Text: Play this card on an Evolutionary Adversary immediately after the Combat has ended, when that Adversary played is sent to the Discard Pile. You can start another Combat with the same Adversary for half cost (rounded up) against the same Team of Agents.
Dialogue: Scully: "Mulder, I don't know what you're getting at here. Regeneration of an entire body?. I don't know why I'm standing here listening to this."

name: Agent Ambrose Chapel
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Ambrose Chapel. Discard one token during any skill check to add 1 to Ambrose Chapel's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill. If Ambrose Chapel's Team is attacked by the Alien Bounty Hunter, Chapel may not participate in the Combat, but he may still contribute to the Site skill check.
Bio: Ambrose Chapel is an Agent that works for the Central Intelligence Agency (C.I.A.). He was impersonated by the Alien Bounty Hunter.

name: Agent Chesty Short
Game Effect: Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token during your Briefing Phase as Directed player to be able to purchase one additional card from your Bureau deck after the first purchase of cards. You must still pay for each card drawn this way.
Bio: Agent Chesty Short is a bureaucratic figure that criticizes Mulder and Scully's investigations' expense and efficacy. He doubts their belief in aliens and symbolizes the bureaucratic skepticism that often opposes Mulder and Scully's pursuit of the paranormal.

name: Agent Craig Willmore
Game Effect: If Agent Craig Willmore is in the same Team as Agent Pendrell, Willmore gains a +1 to his SCIENCES skill, and a -1 to his ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill.
Bio: Craig Willmore is a Special Agent for the FBI field office in Seattle, Washington. On April 2, 1996, he was assigned to investigate the disappearance of Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully.

name: Agent Diana Fowley
Game Effect: Agent Fowley allows you to choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during the Briefing Phase. If Agent Fowley is in the same Team as Agent Dana Scully, both gain a -1 to their cumulative CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills.
Bio: As an FBI Special Agent, Diana Fowley investigated Gibson Praise with Agent Spender before joining Mulder's search for an Alien Hybrid. Despite her involvement, her motivations remained mysterious, leading to speculation about her ties to the Syndicate and her role with Mulder.

name: Agent Flagler
Game Effect: Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token during your Briefing Phase as Active player to be able to purchase one additional card from your Bureau deck after the first purchase of cards. You must still pay for each card drawn this way.
Bio: Agent Flagler is a meticulous investigator that analyzes evidence and handwriting samples for the FBI. Flagler's attention to detail contributed to unraveling a mysterious kidnapping case, collaborating with Mulder and Scully.

name: Agent Gene Crane
Game Effect: Agent Crane's BUREAUCRACY and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills are increased by one if he and Agent Doggett are on the same Team.
Bio: Special Agent Gene Crane worked under Deputy Director Alvin Kersh, assisting in key cases like the search for Mulder and the Zeus Genetics investigation. In late 2001, he was replaced by a super soldier, as part of an alien plot.

name: Agent Hedin
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Agent Hedion. Discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add any Keyword COMPUTER card to your hand. Show the card to your opponent and shuffle the deck.
Bio: Agent Hedin assisted in the investigation by matching fingerprints found on the stairwell to Michael Kritschgau, an employee of the Pentagon's research division, leading to a pivotal breakthrough in identifying Scully's attacker.

name: Agent Jeffrey Spender
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any on Keyword MOTIVE or RESULT Site card. Add that card to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau deck.
Bio: Jeffrey Frank Spender is the son of the Cigarette Smoking Man and Cassandra Spender, as well as the paternal half-brother of Agent Fox Mulder. He worked as a Special Agent in the FBI, assigned to the X-Files unit, partnered with Agent Diana Fowley.

name: Agent John Doggett
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token to negate one Bluff. Additionally, if Agent Doggett is on the same Team as Agent Scully, change her Keyword SKEPTIC to BELIEVER.
Bio: John Doggett is a no-nonsense Agent who frequently applies his down to earth sensibilities. A former a marine and NYPD detective, Doggett joined The X-Files, partnering with Dana Scully and later Monica Reyes, investigating unsolved cases with mysterious or supernatural elements. His son Luke Doggett was abducted and murdered.

name: Agent Kallenbrunner
Game Effect: Place one token on Agent Kallenbrunner. Discard this token to negate a Witness card played by your opponent. This token cannot be replaced.
Bio: A key prosecutor on Mulder's trial, Agent Kallenbrunner is a prominent figure within the Syndicate. He is skeptical of alien conspiracies and uses harsh tactics to discredit witnesses like Scully or Spender. His role reflects his commitment to upholding the government's cover-up and suppressing the truth'.

name: Agent Krycek, Killed by Skinner
Text: If your opponent includes Agent Krycek in any skill check in the Field, Agent Krycek is instantly killed and removed from the game.
Dialogue: "It's going to take more bullets than you can… ever fire to win this game. But one bullet… and I can give you a thousand lives." - Alex Krycek

name: Agent Leyla Harrison
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION cards. If you spend this [RP], you may replace it during the Briefing Phase if Leyla Harrison is in the same Team as Agents Monica Reyes or John Doggett.
Bio: Leyla Harrison was an agent assigned to the FBI. She transitioned from the accounting office to the X-Files unit. Leyla admirably pieced together Mulder and Scully's adventures, later assisting Reyes and Doggett in their investigations.

name: Agent Medical Escort
Text: One Agent (your choice) may immediately "escort" another Agent in the same Team if forced to go to the Hospital (only if chosen Agent is not required to go to the Hospital too). The escorted Agent may remove three additional points of damage while being accompanied during the next healing phase.
Dialogue: "I just wanted to make sure you got where you were going safely." - Scully

name: Agent Monica Reyes
Game Effect: If Agent Monica Reyes is in the Field, all Site cards with Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION may be played for 1 [RP] less.
Bio: Assigned to the X-Files alongside Agent John Doggett, Monica Reyes was initially skeptical but later embraced belief in the paranormal. She's characterized by her intuition, open-mindedness, and spiritual inclinations. Reyes' dynamic nature adds depth to the investigative team, balancing skepticism with a willingness to explore unexplained phenomena.

name: Agent Monica Reyes at Death's Door
Text: If your opponent includes Agent Monica Reyes in any skill check in the Field, the Agent is instantly killed and removed from the game. Your opponent may play the card Audrey Pauley to negate the effects of this card. Agent Monica Reyes takes no damage and Audrey Pauley is killed instead. Remove the Witness card from the game, whether it was already in play or not.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "They all think you're dead" – Audrey Pauley

name: Agent Mosley Drummy
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any one Equipment card that increases CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill. Add it to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.
Bio: FBI Agent Mosley Drummy led investigations, aiding in high-profile cases alongside Mulder and Scully. Known for skepticism, pivotal role in arrests, and leadership during crises. Involved in capturing notorious criminals, including modern-day Frankenstein Doctor.

name: Agent on Demand
Text: Search through your Bureau Deck and select an Agent with a Cost of 3 or less [RP] (X), and place it in the Bureau section with this card attached. If this card is negated, remove it as well as the selected Agent from the game. During the Briefing Phase, pay X [RP] upkeep or discard this card and the selected Agent. Ignore the Agent's Game Effect.
Dialogue: "Craig, it looks like we got some invited guests…" - Mulder

name: Agent Pathogen Treatment
Text: Play this card to negate any Keyword ALIEN MANIPULATION card or to heal 1 point of damage on any Agent in the Hospital.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "First Elder: "What good was that knowledge? Without the vaccine against the black oil, no one can survive."Well Manicured Man: "We have a vaccine. Developed by the Russians, stolen by Krycek, given to me."

name: Agent Peyton Ritter
Game Effect: Agent Peyton Ritter's BUREAUCRACY skill is increased by one if he and Deputy Alvin Kersh are on the same Team. If Agent Peyton Ritter is in the same Team as Agent Dana Scully, she loses one HEALTH.
Bio: Agent Peyton Ritter accompanied Scully to investigate Alfred Fellig, a crime scene photographer suspected of staging deaths. Ritter exhibited a single-minded focus on building a case against Fellig, disregarding Scully's cautious approach and revealing a dependency on the directives of his superior, Alvin Kersh.

name: Agent Rice
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Agent Rice. Any time during a Combat involving Agent Rice you may discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add a Combat card to your hand. Show the card to your opponent and shuffle the deck.
Bio: Agent Rice led the SWAT response, coordinating with Scully during a hostage situation. Despite initial resistance, he contacted Mulder's captor, Gary Lambert, who demanded to broadcast a message, escalating the tense standoff.

name: Agent Schoniger
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token to move Agent Dana Scully from anywhere on the table to the Team Agent Schoniger is in. Scully may assist in any skill check made by the team. In this manner, Scully may assist on two Sites in one turn.
Bio: Agent Schoniger, with 30 years of FBI experience, assists Scully in analyzing Mulder's hypnosis tape about Samantha's abduction, attributing Mulder's memories to compensatory fantasy, and believes Samantha was likely killed in 1973.

name: Agent Thomas
Game Effect: Place a [RP] token on this card. This may be used to pay for for any CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or BEHAVIORAL cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your briefing phase.
Bio: Agent Thomas helped FBI agents Mulder and Scully to find traces that lead them to Lucas Henry, by showing Liz Hawley, a series of Polaroid photographs of a possible suspect.

name: Agent's Verschwinden
Text: Select one Agent from the Team investigating this Site. That Agent, along with any cards attached beneath it, is placed face up twelve cards down into the owning player's Bureau deck. When the Agent card reaches the top of the deck, the Agent and all cards attached to it are immediately deployed to the Field (undamaged).
Dialogue: "Why? Why me, Gerry? Do I remind you of your sister? Why did your sister kill herself, Gerry?" - Scully

name: Agents' Recharge
Text: Play this card at the beginning of the Case Assignment or the Investigation Phases to get an additional Healing phase this turn. After that extra phase, go directly to the Debriefing phase. Remove this card from the game.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "I'm taking a bubble bath." - Skinner

name: Alfred Fellig
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. Alternately, any card that would send Dana Scully to the Hospital may be negated by playing this card. If played this way, remove Alfred Fellig from the game. This card cannot be played during a Combat and it is not a Healing card.
Dialogue: "Do you see him? Don't look. Close your eyes…" - Alfred Fellig

name: Alien Abduction
Text: Force a Team in the Field to make an ALIEN INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check. If they fail, attach this card to any Agent in that Team (your choice) and remove the Agent from play. During the next Agent's controller Healing phase, move the Agent to the Hospital (undamaged).
Dialogue: "Agent Mulder?! Mulder!" - Skinner

name: Alien DNA Drain
Text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand to force your opponent to discard the same cards from their hand (opponent's choice).
Dialogue: "You see, the alien fetus would give us the alien genome… the DNA with which we could make a human hybrid. A new race, Agent Mulder." - The Cigarette Smoking Man

name: Alien Relic Unveiled
Text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SCIENCES skill check.
Dialogue: "Yes, get me the international operator, please. I need to place a call to the United States." - Dr. Merkmallen

name: Alien Spider Host
Text: Attach the Alien Spider to an Agent in a Team of two or more Agents. That Agent becomes aggressive and attacks their own Team sequentially, one by one (your choice). Then the infected Agent moves on to the next Agent, until all Agents are defeated or until he is sent to the Hospital. Discard this card afterwards.
Dialogue: "I'm dead, too, inside, because of this thing they put in me. For what? To turn me into some kind of killing machine, or just to see what would happen?" - Edward Skur

name: All Lies Lead to the Truth
Text: Place this card in one of your opponents Fields. Your opponent must subtract 1 from the [CP] he generates each turn while this card is in his Field. Your opponent may pay 5 [CP] to force you to discard this card.
Dialogue: "When I went to work for the FBI, I didn't know of my father's crimes. When I stood up to him, he shot me." - Jeffrey Spender

name: Alvin Kurtzweil
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword BUREAUCRACY or GOVERNMENT card is played.
Dialogue: "There's something you don't know about the bombing in Dallas." - A. Kurtzweil

name: Ammunition Reload
Text: Play this card on any Agent during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round to double that Agent's LRC skill. This effect must be applied before any other modifier and only over the LRC listed on that Agent's card.
Dialogue: "Protect me and mine with your quickening power." - Jared Chirp

name: Animated Snakes
Text: Play this card for 2 [CP] less if played on a Site card with the Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION.
Dialogue: Scully: "..Maybe it's symbolic. I mean, serpents and religion have gone hand in hand. They've represented the temptation of Eve -- Original Sin. They've been feared and hated throughout history as they've been thought to embody Satan -- to serve Evil itself".

name: Apology is Policy
Text: Play this card to change a negative skill check modifier to a positive one (e.g., a -1 becomes a +1).
Dialogue: Scully: "Apology has become policy."Mulder: "I don't need an apology for the lies."

name: Aquatic Nightmare
Dialogue: Scully: "I don't think these wounds are bites or stings. There's something in here, Mulder, right under the skin."

name: Area 51, Groom Lake, NV
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "Some whistle-blower working inside the so-called Area 51. Said he had some "big deal" information. I got to tell you... The whole thing turned out to be just one gigantic mistake on our part." - Mulder

name: Arthur Dales
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 3+.
Dialogue: "You don't have much time to get to the airport but if you're the X-Files man you say you are you better get your butt in gear." - Arthur Dales

name: ASAC Dakota Whitney
Game Effect: ASAC Dakota Whitney's OBSERVATION and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills are increased by one if she and Agent Mosley Drummy are on the same Team.
Bio: Dakota Whitney is an ASAC and a Special Agent in Charge at the FBI. While investigating the deaths of multiple abductees, she was instrumental in arranging the involvement of Agents Mulder and Scully.

name: Ashen Whispers
Text: Play this card on any Agent in a Team including Agent Charles Burk to use that Agent's COMPUTER skill number for any one EVIDENCE COLLECTION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "It's called vibuti - holy ash. Technically, it's known as an apport - something that materializes out of thin air." - Charles Burk

name: Assistant Director Brad Follmer
Game Effect: Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 1 to Follmer's BUREAUCRACY or OBSERVATION skill.
Bio: Assistant Director Brad Follmer had a romantic history with Monica Reyes that he briefly brought up while trying to keep her away from the X-Files. Despite his political maneuvers and skepticism towards the X-Files, he aided Doggett in a crucial investigation. However, his involvement in organized crime tainted his reputation, leaving his future uncertain, possibly facing criminal charges.

name: Astral Alignment Anomaly
Text: Attach this card to any Agent at the moment a Game Effect token is about to be removed from that Agent. That token is removed without applying its effect. Remove all remaining Game Effect tokens from that Agent. While this card is in play, that Agent cannot receive any Game Effect tokens. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.
Dialogue: White: "Maybe we solve the mystery of the horny beast."

name: Audrey Pauley
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check, or play this card when one of your Agents must go to the Hospital with zero HEALTH to remove half of the damage tokens (rounded up). The Agent must still go to the Hospital.
Dialogue: "I told you. She's not gone." - Audrey Pauley

name: B.A.T.F. Reinforcements
Text: Play this card on target Team during a Combat to get an extra combatant in that Team with following skills: LRC: 3, CRC: 2, HEALTH: 5. Discard this card after the Combat phase has ended.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Is there contact with the temple?"Agent: "If you call that contact."

name: Backheld
Text: Play this card on any combatant in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round to reduce the damage from any one source by one point.
Dialogue: "Let him go, you hear me? Let him go!" - Reyes

name: Barnes Cornes, NY
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Excuse me, sir, Max Fenig?"Gardener: "Over there."

name: Battle Expertise
Text: Target Agent or Adversary gains an extra LRC/CRC bonus skill equal to the number of Combat cards in your Discard pile.
Dialogue: "He's got a gun" - Mulder

name: Believe to Understand
Text: Force an opponent Team investigating a Site to make a ALIEN INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately.
Dialogue: "The map to our human genetic makeup every gene on every chromosome -- proof of what I've been saying. If only we could find more pieces." - Doctor Sandoz

name: Berkowitz House, Indiana, IN
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "That repulsive physiognomy is the vilest perversion of science." - Pollidori

name: Beth Kane
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "Doctor Larson gave him vitamin shots. He gave them to a lot of kids. He said it was like treating their teeth with fluoride… as a preventative measure." - Beth Kane

name: Betty Templeton
Text: This You may search your Bureau deck for the "Lulu Pfeiffer" Adversary card and play it immediately, ignoring Activator requirements. If you do, both Adversaries attack simultaneously (treat as one Combat). Double both cards' CRC and HEALTH, and skip the LONG RANGE COMBAT round.
Dialogue: "What are you doing here?" - Betty Templeton

name: Billy Miles, Resurrected
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Move up to two Agents in the Team investigating this site (your choice) to the Hospital with zero HEALTH. The Agent(s) may not leave the Hospital until fully healed. Combat cards cannot be used against this Adversary.
Dialogue: "Billy Miles? He did this?" - Scully

name: Bio-medical Division Card
Text: Discard this card to change the Site Prerequisite to MEDICAL or SUBTERFUGE in a Site investigated by the Agent equipped with this card. Keywords of the Site card are also changed.
Dialogue: "It's the tip of the iceberg. You and Mulder are the only ones who can bring it to light." - Deep Throat

name: Biochip Implant
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Field to reduce their HEALTH by one. Opponents may play ALIEN MANIPULATION cards that affect that Agent at half cost (rounded up). Discard this card if the Agent visits the Hospital or if the Team he belongs makes a successful MEDICAL or SCIENCES +7 skill check.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "It's the same thing I had removed from my own neck." - Scully

name: Biohazard Protection Suit
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill. Agents equipped with this card are not affected by ALIEN MANIPULATION cards. Additionally, you can discard this card to add one to the Agent's SCIENCES skill.
Dialogue: "It looks like a nest... some type of black vermiform organism attached to the pineal gland..." - Scully

name: Blazing Pages
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to OCCULT INVESTIGATION 3+.
Dialogue: Scully: "Where are you going?" Mulder: "To see a man about a burning book."

name: Blevins' Inquiry
Text: Force one Agent with the Keyword SKEPTIC (your choice) to go back to the Bureau immediately. The Agent may not contribute to any skill checks this turn.
Dialogue: Blevins: "Agent Scully. Please have a seat."

name: Blinding Predator
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. Target Agent (your choice) in the Team attacked by the Blinding Predator receives a poisonous attack and is considered "blinded" for the first CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round. That Agent will deal no damage during that round of combat.
Dialogue: "Whatever happened to Sacks, I think it's happening to me. I'm completely blind now." - Leyla Harrison

name: Briefed on Secrets
Text: Discard an Equipment card in play (your choice).
Dialogue: "I'm starting to get used to the dark." - Skinner

name: Bruckman's Foretelling
Text: During the Briefing Phase, place a token on Clyde Bruckman's card only once the starting token has been removed. This token is usable in the same way as the starting token. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: Mulder: "How do you know where to go?"Bruckman: "I just know."Mulder: "But how do you know?"Bruckman: "I don't know!"

name: Burning Loyalties
Text: Play this card to negate one Witness RESOURCE immediately or to prevent the investigating player from playing any Witnesses while investigating this Site, except for Witnesses which would specifically negate this card.
Dialogue: "The eyes are the windows of the soul. They tell you everything you need to know about a person. So tell me, are you lying?" - Dwight Cooper

name: Caballero, Memory Vampire
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Play this card in your Field section. Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token anytime to look at the top three cards of your opponent's Bureau deck or to avoid an Agent to heal damage tokens during the Healing phase. When no tokens remain, move this card to the discard pile.
Dialogue: "¿Dónde está el americano ahorita?" - Caballero

name: Cadet Rudolph Hayes
Game Effect: Rudolph Hayes' CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION and OCCULT INVESTIGATION skills are increased by one if he and Agent John Doggett are on the same Team.
Bio: John Stuart Mimms, using the alias Rudolph Hayes, joined the FBI. He helped Agent John Doggett investigate his son's murder and the murders of two women. Mimms provided crucial information and was wrongly accused by A.D. Brad Follmer before proving his innocence.

name: Caledonia, WI
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "It's too late to help me. I can't help myself anymore." - Skur

name: Cassandra Spender
Text: Adds zero to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check. If this card is used in a successful Site investigation, the owning player may ask "Is your X-File's Affiliation Alien?" in addition to the Site question for zero cost.
Dialogue: "Cassandra Spender is, indeed, the mother of Agent Jeffrey Spender and the ex-wife of C.G.B. Spender. She was first abducted in 1973 on the night of November 27."

name: Cerulean Hunt
Text: You can change up to two cards from your hand with a similar number of Bluffs that you have already played on a Site and are still in play (face down). The new Bluffs under the Site can still be negated.
Dialogue: "Appears as if he died from ingesting paint." - Scully

name: Chaco Chicken Plant, Dudley, AR
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "Chickens feed on chickens?" - Mulder

name: Charles Wesley Gotts
Text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one Keyword PAWN Adversary.
Dialogue: "Who? Who's gunnin' for me?" - Charles Wesley Gotts

name: ChemElement Analyzer
Text: Agents equipped with a ChemElement Analyzer have access to the field office crime lab. Adds 1 to the Agent's SCIENCES and SUBTERFUGE skills.
Dialogue: "Sample analysis is showing carbon, bromide, boron and calcium." - Scully

name: Chrissy Giorgio
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to ALIEN INVESTIGATION 3+.
Dialogue: "I'm in a room… on a spaceship… surrounded by aliens." - Chrissy Giorgio

name: Christmas Retreat
Text: You may take a second purchase of cards after your first one (during the Briefing Phase). Then, go directly to the Case Assignment phase. Remove this card from the game. The effects of this card cannot be negated.
Dialogue: Melissa Scully: "You don't know who you're going to meet when you join the FBI. You don't know how your life is going to change or how you're going to change the life of others…"

name: Chuck Forsch
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION Or adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.
Dialogue: Scully: "Does anybody else know about these pictures, Chuck?"Chuck: "Nurse Innes."

name: Chung's Cosmic Goliath
Text: This card does not initiate Combat. Pick one Agent from an investigating Team. That Agent remains "confused" until end of turn and cannot contribute his or her skills to any Site skill check.
Dialogue: "Jack... what is that thing?" - Alien

name: Coats Grove, MI
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: Scully: "What I have concluded is that this man's head was held forcibly down in the Michigan mud just a little too long."

name: Cocoon
Text: Play this card to return target Equipment card to the owner's hand.
Dialogue: Mulder: "It's amazing how things change, isn't it?"Scully: "The Caterpillar?Mulder: "No, a change for us. It's coming"

name: Computer Forensic Holly Rice
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Remove one token to add a +1 modifier to any COMPUTER or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check made by the Team including Polly.
Bio: Holly, a government worker for the FBI, worked in the Computer Records Office. Influenced by "Pusher" Robert Patrick Modell, she leaked confidential records. She also worked in the FBI Communications Center, investigating repeated calls to Skinner's floor, while remaining friends with Agent Dana Scully.

name: Conrad Lozano
Game Effect: Treat Agent Conrad Lozano as RES 1 if the Team he belongs makes an ALIEN INVESTIGATION 5+ skill during the Briefing Phase.
Bio: Lozano is of Mexican descent but is American by nationality. He works at the INS Service Processing Center in Fresno, CA. Despite his skepticism, Lozano agrees to help Agent Mulder locate Eladio Buente, indicating his willingness to assist in the investigation despite his doubts about the supernatural elements involved.

name: Covering the Killer
Text: Play this card on a Team investigating a Site to increase that Site Prerequisite by two.
Dialogue: "I protected you as long as I could. I won't any longer." - Karin Berquist

name: Covering up Evidence
Text: Play this card to return one Keyword RESOURCE card to the owner's hand.
Dialogue: "They called me in tonight …and they said they're going to reassign us to other sections." - Mulder

name: Cradock Marine Bank, 8th St, Washington D.C.
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "You can end this the right way." - Mulder

name: Critical Countdown
Text: If your opponent plays any card on this Site, it will automatically cause two points of damage to every Agent in a Team investigating the Site. If you play any card, empty your [CP] pool afterwards.
Dialogue: "We got no time Dana. We'll find another way." - Agent Doggett

name: Cross-team Support
Text: Play this card to allow one Agent on a Team in the Field to add their skills to one skill check that is occurring in another Site in the Field being investigated by another Team. The Agent's skill is reduced by 1 (i.e., Skill: 2 becomes Skill: 1). LRC and CRC may not be added.
Dialogue: "Monica? You're not gonna believe this. We found two more cases. Two more victims to add to this thing." - Doggett

name: Crump Residence, Montello, NE
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: Scully: "The pathology of this thing… It affects the inner ear and this area right here is ground zero. What if what we're looking for is some kind of a sound?"

name: Cult Carnage
Text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness during the Investigation phase. The Witness card is discarded. Instead, that Witness joins the Temple of the Seven Stars and will attack one of the Agents in that Team (your choice) only during an LRC round.
Dialogue: "I knew you were coming. I've known for nine centuries. It was written in the Revelation of Jesus Christ...." - Vernon Ephesian

name: Danielle Manley
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.
Dialogue: "I had this dream… had it many times. That they put Neech in that chair and they flipped the switch, but that he wouldn't die. They couldn't kill him. He's a powerful man." - Danielle Manley

name: Dark Dealings
Text: Subtract 4 from one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check.
Dialogue: "Please, don't take my baby! Please, don't take my baby! Wayne! Wayne!" - Laura Weinsider

name: Dead Zone
Text: Place this card in any Section of your opponent's side of the table. While this card is in play, no Agent in that Section may contribute their skills to skill checks in another Section of the table. The player controlling this Section may pay 4 [RP] to discard this card.
Dialogue: "Before William was kidnapped, Byers was able to tuck a cell phone under the padding of the baby" – Scully

name: Deal Master
Text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase. The next [RP] card you discard this turn will generate twice as many [CP] tokens as its [RP] cost.
Dialogue: "It's not the cards. It's playing the hand you were dealt. Well, you guys get a bad deal, it's all in what you do with it. You know what I'm saying, pardner?" - Mr. Burt

name: Deceive, Inveigle, Obfuscate
Text: Play this card to add or decrease by two any Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.
Dialogue: "I've never underestimated Mulder. I still don't." - The Cigarette-Smoking Man

name: Deceptive Visions
Text: During this turn, you may change the BELIEVER, SKEPTIC, or NEUTRAL keyword of any one Agent in play to another of these keywords. If the Agent does not already have one of these keywords, you may add one of them to the Agent.
Dialogue: "I tore this off my New York Knicks T-shirt. It has nothing to do with the crime." - Mulder

name: Deep Throat
Text: Ask any one Characteristic question regarding one opponent's X-File. Remove this card from the game. The effects of this card may not be negated.
Dialogue: "You've seen things that weren't to be seen. Care and discretion, are now imperative." - Deep Throat

name: Deep Throat's Demise
Text: Play this card to empty both player's pools ([RP] and [CP]).
Dialogue: "You and Mulder are the only ones that can bring it to light." - Deep Throat

name: Demonic Puppet
Text: The Demonic Puppet initiates Combat but does not assign nor receive any damage. Instead, the selected Agent in a Team inflicts a wound upon himself or herself equal to the sum of their LRC & CRC values, applied only once. Healing cards may be used to prevent damage, including any Combat cards that do not modify LRC and/or CRC.
Dialogue: Scully: "Give me the doll, Polly."

name: Deny Everything
Text: Play this card immediately after your opponent asks you a question. You may respond with this phrase: "I can neither confirm nor deny that assumption." After playing this card remove it from the game.
Dialogue: "We have a vaccine. Developed by the Russians, stolen by Krycek, given to me." - The Well-Manicured Man

name: Deputy Alvin Kersh
Game Effect: Treat Dep. Director Alvin Kersh as a RES 3 if he is in the Bureau Section of the table. Kersh also allows you to choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during the Briefing Phase.
Bio: Alvin Kersh obstructed Mulder and Scully's paranormal investigations, assigning them mundane tasks, later Overseeing their work. Kersh, a former U.S. Air Force pilot, brought military discipline to his role. His skepticism towards the X-Files drove bureaucratic actions, often impeding the Agents their pursuit of the Truth.

name: Detective Barron
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Detective Barron. Discard a token to play a Bluff card from your hand at half its cost. Additionally, Barron's BEHAVIORAL and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills are increased by one if he and Agent Kelly Ryan are in the same Team.
Bio: Barron was a detective with the Richmond, Virginia police and the superior of Kelly Ryan. He was an extremely short-tempered man who viewed the involvement of the FBI as an intrusion onto his turf.

name: Detective John Kresge
Game Effect: If Detective Kresge is in the same Team as Agent Scully, they both gain a +1 to their cumulative OBSERVATION and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills, and a -1 to their SUBTERFUGE and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills.
Bio: Detective John Kresge was a seasoned San Diego police officer that assisted Agent Dana Scully in investigating Mrs. Roberta Sim's apparent suicide. He updated her on Marshall Sim's confession regarding the murder case. This interaction showcases Kresge's role as a reliable ally to Scully.

name: Detective Kelly Ryan
Game Effect: Place one token on Detective Kelly Ryan. Discard a token to look through your Bureau deck any time during the game to draw any one Bluff card. Show the Bluff to your opponent and shuffle the deck.
Bio: Kelly Ryan became a detective with the Richmond Police Department in Virginia after being tutored as a student of Dana Scully. She asked for assistance from Scully and Mulder when investigating a bizarre series of murders and while searching for Dr. Chester Ray Banton.

name: Detective Norman
Game Effect: Detective Norman's LONG RANGE COMBAT skill is doubled against any EVOLUTIONARY adversary played on any Team he belongs. Additionally, if Detective Norman is in any Team including Fox Mulder, add 1 to Norman's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill.
Bio: Norman was a detective with the Newark County Police Department who was Mulder's contact in New Jersey on what Mulder initially thought was a routine homicide investigation.

name: Detective Pennock
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Remove a token to look through your Bureau deck to draw any keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck.
Bio: Lloyd Pennock was part of the local police force in Wilmington, Delaware. He investigated a murder at Paradise Motel and encountered Marty Glenn, a blind woman, near the victim. Collaborating with Mulder and Scully, Pennock navigated the enigma, maintaining an open mind in uncovering Marty's mysterious Capabilities.

name: Detective Waltos
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token to search your Bureau deck for an Equipment card with a cost of 2 [RP] or less and add it to your hand. Reveal the card to your opponent and shuffle your deck. If the card is "Lie Detector", you may attach it to Waltos immediately for zero cost, during the Requisition Phase.
Bio: Detective Waltos was in charge of the investigation into the murder of Carina Sayles, of which Assistant Director Walter Skinner was accused. Skinner, a suspect in the murder case, was uncooperative, refusing to take a lie-detector test.

name: Die Wahrheit ist irgendwo da draußen
Text: Play this card to force an opponent Team currently investigating a Site to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail only Agents with the Keyword FBI may contribute their skills to any skill check made on this Site.
Dialogue: Mulder: "This ship's been caught in something called the devil's triangle. It's some kind of time warp. A rift in space."

name: Dio Ti Ama
Text: Place this card in your field. The cost of all [RP] cards you play this turn is halved (rounded up). Discard this card at the end of this turn. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.
Dialogue: Scully: "She found me."Mulder: "So you could save her."

name: Distracting Vision
Text: Pick the top 5 cards from your Bureau deck and show them to your opponent. You may play one revealed Bluff card at half cost (rounded up), if any. Shuffle the rest back into your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: "According to Skinner's psychiatrist, he's been experiencing a recurring dream in which he's confronted by an old woman." - Scully

name: Doctor Lorenz
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's MEDICAL or adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.
Dialogue: "High serotonin levels have been associated with mania." - Doctor Lorenz

name: Donnie's Deadly Game
Text: This card can only be played during the Case Assignment Phase to return a Site card played by your opponent back to their hand.
Dialogue: Satin: "You want me to shampoo my hair?"Donnie: "I'm happy to pay extra, if that's something out of the ordinary."

name: Doppelganger Agent
Text: Play this card at the beginning of the Briefing Phase. Remove target Agent from play (Equipment and tokens included) and replace it with this card, representing a doppelganger with all skills reduced by one. Owner may use the Agent normally. At the end of the turn, discard this card and return the original Agent.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "Who called the cops?" - Eddie Van Blundht

name: Double Agent
Text: Play this card at the end of the Briefing Phase to move any number of tokens from your [RP] pool to your [CP] pool or vice versa. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: "Keeping Fox Mulder down is not a job. It's your dirty work!" - Spender

name: Dr. Simon Bruin
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword SCIENCES or EVOLUTIONARY card is played.
Dialogue: Dr. Bruin: "You'd be amazed what I've seen removed from people's throats in emergency rooms."Scully: "There's no mistake. This patient has no pituitary gland."

name: Drowned Resources
Text: Play this card to discard all Keyword RESOURCE cards in play.
Dialogue: "Do me a favor, Mulder. Let me say it. Reincarnation." - Scully

name: E pur si muove
Text: Both players must discard their entire hands and draw seven cards from the top of their respective Bureau Decks.
Dialogue: "From Space, it seems an abstraction --a magician's trick on a darkened stage. And from this distance one might never imagine that it is alive.." - Scully

name: Edge of the Unknown
Text: Place this card next to your X-File. You may draw one card for free in each of your opponents' Briefing Phases. You may only have one of this card in play.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Scully, ya gotta see this! Scully!"Scully: "I see it."

name: Electric Anomalies
Text: All Agents in a Team must discard all attached Keyword ELECTRICAL Equipment immediately.
Dialogue: "The entire electrical system was shorted out. All the circuitry and wiring had melted." - Scully

name: Electro-Chemical Link
Text: Attach this card to an Agent you control and place two tokens on it. During each Briefing Phase, remove one token to add +2 to that Agent's RES value. Discard this card when all tokens are removed.
Dialogue: "Everything about insects is fascinating. They are truly remarkable creatures. So beautiful, and so honest." - Bambi Berembaum

name: Ellen Adderly
Text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. This card is free and Activator requirements are ignored if it is played on a Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site.
Dialogue: "Then what? My marriage, my life… everything I thought I had… is nothing. It's all lies. I wish you'd never come here." - Ellen Adderly

name: Eluding the Oubliette
Text: Play this card to remove one token from any Bluff card that forces an Agent to remain in any section (or be removed from the game) for each 3 [RP] spent. (i.e.: if 6 [RP] are paid, you may remove 2 tokens).
Dialogue: "Who are you? What do you want? Why are you doing this? Please… I want to go home." - Amy

name: Elusive Fugitive
Text: Play on any PAWN or PRIMORDIAL Adversary to negate all damage allocated to that Adversary this round.
Dialogue: "Hold the line, gentlemen! Look left! Look right! Hold the line!" - Agent Drummy

name: Elusive Informant
Text: Play this card to add or decrease by two any Team's BUREAUCRACY or ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "U.S. Government knew about the Black Cancer. They lied. Didn't have no cure… no inoculation… I think we'll quit right there. I got nothing more to say." - Terry E. Mayhew

name: Emergency Admission
Text: Place this card in the Hospital. Once per turn, during the Healing phase, you can remove from play a card from your hand to heal one point of damage to an Agent in the Hospital.
Dialogue: "Blood pressure is 67 on palpatation." - Nurse

name: Emergency Evacuation
Text: Play this card at the end of any Combat round to allow up to two Agents in that Team to leave the Combat if their HEALTH was not reduced to zero yet. Both Agents may still contribute their skills to other skill checks and be moved to the Hospital this turn.
Dialogue: "I want an apology for the truth." - Mulder

name: Emergency Quarantine
Text: Place this card in the Field. You can avoid an attack of an Adversary played by your opponent by placing it under this card. It will attack on the next Site you play ignoring any activators. Discard this card afterwards.
Dialogue: "I told her it was going to be a nice trip to the forest." - Mulder

name: Emily
Text: Apply a +1 modifier to any one skill check made by a Team of Agents in the Field during the Investigation phase.
Dialogue: "Have you ever seen Mr. Potato head?" - Mulder

name: Erwin Lukesh
Text: Play this card on a team of Agents. The Agents in that team cannot deliver any damage to Erwin Lukesh during the LONG RANGE COMBAT round unless they have OBSERVATION or SUBTERFUGE skills. Erwin Lukesh may use SUBTERFUGE cards.
Dialogue: "God, I enjoyed it.  You bled just like a pig" - Erwin Lukesh

name: Esther Nairn
Text: Play this card to negate the Adversary card 'Kill Switch'. Alternatively, you can attach Esther Nairn to any Agent in the Field to add 1 to that Agent's COMPUTER skill once per tur while the Agent is in the Field. Discard Esther Nairn when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Are you "Invisigoth?"Esther: "How did you find me?"

name: Evasive Adversary
Text: Play on any PRIMORDIAL Adversary to reduce damage from all opponent LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT sources by 1 this round.
Dialogue: "We have an agent alone with a sicko who cutting out women's tongues, a guy known for his vanishing act." - Doggett

name: Everything Dies
Text: Place this card in the Field. As long as this card is in play, any Agent whose HEALTH value is reduced to zero is instantly killed and removed from the game. If any player loses all their Agents, that player loses the game.
Dialogue: "I can't truly believe I'm really standing here." - Scully

name: Executive Assistant Arlene
Game Effect: Treat Arlene as RES 2 if she and Assistant Director Walter Skinner are both in the Bureau.
Bio: Arlene worked as an executive assistant for the FBI. She helped Assistant Director Walter Skinner and the FBI investigate various cases and incidents, and was present during significant events involving Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully.

name: Eyes of Obedience
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite from CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION to OCCULT INVESTIGATION.
Dialogue: Father Gregory: "Whatever your intentions… your secular prejudices blind you from seeing what's really happening here."

name: Face Mask
Text: Adds two to the Agent's HEALTH.
Dialogue: "The parasite is undetectable in the bloodstream. This is the only way to test whether or not you've been infected." - Osbourne

name: Faceless Alien Rebel
Text: At the start of each Combat round you may play one Combat card from your Discard Pile (at normal cost). Remove from the game each Combat card played this way. Subtract one from all damage sources applied to this Adversary during the LRC round.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "Plans that would have worked had not a rebel alien race come to destroy them." - The Cigarette Smoking Man

name: Faith Departure
Text: Subtract 4 from one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "There are more worlds than the one you can hold in your hand." - Albert Hosteen

name: Fateful Omen
Text: Remove from play any Agent with the Keyword FBI in a Team investigating this Site. The Agent may not contribute their skills to any check this turn. Move the Agent back to the Field during the next Briefing Phase.
Dialogue: "This card's not meant for me. It's yours." - Puppet

name: Father Joseph Crissman
Text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's BEHAVIORAL skill once per turn while the Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.
Dialogue: "This is where she was taken. This is where she was attacked." - Father Joe

name: FBI and SWAT Strike
Text: Play this card on any Agent during LONG RANGE COMBAT to add 2 points to that Agent's LRC skill. Additionally, if there is a CRC round, you can reduce the damage from any source by 2 points.
Dialogue: "Federal agent, I'm armed! Exit the vehicle, now!" - Mulder

name: FBI Ballistics Lab
Text: Place this Equipment card in the Bureau section. Once per turn, any Agent in the Bureau may add their COMPUTER or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills to any skill check done by any Team in the Field.
Dialogue: Skinner: "9mm slug. Found it in the alley lodged in the wall. Most likely from the Sig Sauer P226 or 228."

name: FBI Credentialed
Text: Play this card to add the Keyword FBI to any Agent in play (your choice) until the end of the turn.
Dialogue: So, this is Johnny Fabulous, huh? - Gabe Rotter

name: FBI Crossroads
Text: Play this card during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round on a combatant you control with a LRC skill. That combatant and one other combatant of the owning player's choice will deal no damage in this LRC round. Additionally, reduce any combatant's HEALTH by two during the Combat.
Dialogue: Scully: "Damn it, Skinner!Mulder: "Drop your weapon!"Skinner: "Back off!"

name: FBI King County Crime Lab, Seattle
Game Effect: Put a token on one of the Agents in the Team investigating this Site. Discard it to gain a +1 on any Site skill check made by any Team that Agent belongs to.
Prerequisite: Special Equipment required or discard a Witness card from your hand.
Dialogue: "It's industrial-grade lead, used for weighing scuba divers and lining X-ray vests." - John Amis

name: FBI Raid
Text: Play this card during a combat on a Team of Agents to reduce damage from an Adversary's LRC by two points. The team still deals damage during that LRC round.
Dialogue: Scully: "Mulder! The landlady's body! We found her in the bathroom!"

name: FBI Recruit's From Quantico
Text: Once per turn you can pay 4 [RP] to recruit an FBI cadet Agent. Use a token to represent this Agent that can be used to join a Team using these skills: LRC: +2, CRC:+2 and HEALTH: 3. If this card is negated, the token remains. If the Agent is sent to the Hospital, remove it from play. Only one Agent token can be in play.
Dialogue: "I'll see you Monday" – Scully

name: FBI Reinforcement
Text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase to select any Agent card from any player's Discard Pile and play it for half cost (rounded up). The chosen Agent cannot be similar to any of your Agents already in play, you must ignore the Game Effect and you must discard it at the end of this turn.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: Pendrell: "Shouldn't we wait for Agent Scully? Just so I won't have to repeat myself."Mulder: "She's not coming. She's got a date."

name: FBI Safe House, Annandale, Virginia
Question: You may ask on METHOD or one RESULT question. Cost of Adversary cards played on this Site is increased by 2.
Dialogue: "She was waving it under our nose, she was playing with us. Modell told me, he warned me not to play the game. I think it was her game he was talking about." - Mulder

name: Fetishist Women Hunter
Text: Fetishist Women Hunter can engage in Combat with only one female Agent on a Team investigating a Site (your choice).
Dialogue: "Some people collect salt and pepper shakers. The fetishist collects dead things. Hair, fingernails... no one quite knows why, though I've never quite understood salt and pepper shakers myself." - Mulder

name: Field Office Crime Lab (FBI)
Game Effect: Put a token on one of the Agents in the Team investigating this Site. Discard it to gain a +1 on any Site skill check made by any Team that Agent belongs to.
Prerequisite: Special Equipment required or discard a Witness card from your hand.
Dialogue: "It's your sister. We just pulled her body out of the river." - Scully

name: Field Office Crime Lab (FBI)
Game Effect: Put a token on one of the Agents in the Team investigating this Site. Discard it to gain a +1 on any Site skill check made by any Team that Agent belongs to.
Prerequisite: Special Equipment required or discard a Witness card from your hand.
Dialogue: "Agent Mulder, Scully. They killed a US Marshal and then shot Agent Fowley." - Skinner

name: Field Treatment
Text: Play on any Agent in the Field to immediately heal 2 points of damage after an LRC round.
Dialogue: "This is Albert Hosteen. He's been translating your files." - Scully

name: Fight Fire With Fire
Text: Play this card any time after Phoebe Green's game effect token has been removed. Place a new token on Green's card. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: "One tends not to make the same mistake twice." - Phoebe Green

name: Files in Flames
Text: If your opponent asks a question about your X-File at this Site and the answer is 'yes', you may immediately replace your current X-File card with a different one. Each player may only have one copy of this card in their deck.
Dialogue: "This was all strategized - every move. I just couldn't see it. It was all of a plan." - Mulder

name: Finger's Distorted Hypnosis
Text: Play on any Witness card just played to change one skill (and its Keyword) listed on that card to any other skill (your choice) until the end of this turn.
Dialogue: "I'm surrounded by men. Some are in uniforms, some are in suits." - Chrissy Giorgio

name: Finger's Hypnotic Recall
Text: Play on any Witness card just played to change one skill (and its Keyword) listed on that card to any other skill (your choice) until the end of this turn.
Dialogue: "You are feeling very sleepy, very relaxed As your body calmly drifts deeper and deeper into a state of peaceful relaxation…" - Doctor Fingers

name: Fingerprints Erased
Text: Subtract 4 from one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Is that a watch?"Scully: "Yeah."Mulder: "What does it read?Scully: "Eight-oh-one."

name: First Cavalry Church, Nova, VA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "I always said there's three kinds of people in the world: Them who make things happen, them who watch things happen and them who wonder what happened. I made things happen." - Terrance Pruit

name: Forensic Analyst John Amis
Game Effect: John Amis has direct access to the Field Office Crime Lab even without any piece of equipment attached.
Bio: John Amis worked as a forensic analyst at the King County Crime Lab. He helped his friend Craig Willmore, a Special Agent for the FBI Seattle field office, investigate the mystery of the Russian ship Tarakan, and was accidentally subjected to radiation poisoning.

name: Forensic Collection Kit
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's BEHAVIORAL skill.
Dialogue: "This substance.. Did you find it anywhere else in the car?"- Mulder

name: Forensic Face Lab
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's COMPUTER skill. Additionally,you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill.
Dialogue: "You know how an airbag works?" - Pendrell

name: Fortune's Pick
Text: Play this card to search your Bureau Deck for any one Event card with the ACTIVE activator. Show the chosen card to your opponents, then add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
Dialogue: "Mulder: Gee! Very nice. How'd you do that?Scully: "Well… magic."

name: Forward-Looking InfraRed (FLIR)
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's OBSERVATION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to skip a LRC round against a PRIMORDIAL or EVOLUTIONARY Adversary attacking the Team of an Agent equipped with a FLIR.
Dialogue: Jeff: "Detects body heat at 300 yards."

name: Foster City, CA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Mulder, that's what his autopsy shows. From the wound pattern to the blood spray... this man did it to himself, there's no question." - Scully

name: Foum Tataouine, Tunisia
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "He's seen more than he should have." - The Cigarette Smoking Man

name: Fox Mulder, Abducted
Text: Play on a Team of Agents including Fox Mulder to immediately place that Agent ten cards down, face up, in the owning player's Bureau deck. Any equipment and/or token that Mulder had is discarded. When Mulder's card reaches the top of the deck, the Agent's card must be immediately moved to the Hospital (undamaged).
Dialogue: "So you think he was abducted?" - Doggett

name: FPS Corporate Offices, Inland Empire, CA
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.
Dialogue: Langly: "How do you kill something that won't die?"

name: Frank Black
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. Discard this [RP] to look at the top two cards of your deck. Replace the [RP] during your Briefing Phase.
Bio: Frank Black was a former FBI agent who left the bureau to become a freelance consultant. He specialized in criminal profiling and paranormal investigations, often working with the secretive Millennium Group. His psychic abilities, especially his ability to "see" through the eyes of criminals, helped him solve complex and often disturbing cases.

name: Frohike
Text: This card will negate one Event card played on your Team.
Dialogue: Let me at him! I'll kill him!

name: Frozen Vitrification
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite from SCIENCES to BEHAVIORAL .
Dialogue: Dr Yonechi: "Me? No, not yet. No one has solved vitrification."

name: Galpex-Orpheus Platform, Gulf of Mexico
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "That has radioactive properties and can take over a man's body. And it's part of an alien conspiracy to colonise the planet, if I'm not mistaken." - Doggett

name: George and Sherman Peacock's Attack
Text: If any Agent on target Team has an Equipment card attached that increases LRC skill you can attach that card to Peacock's brothers instead (only during the LONG RANGE COMBAT round and only one Equipment card, your choice). Discard that Equipment card if the controlling Agent is sent to the Hospital.
Dialogue: "Where's the other brother... Edmund? " - Mulder

name: Ghostly Haunting
Text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one Keyword PHENOMENA Adversary.
Dialogue: "Dorothy! I need your help." - Leo Kreutzer

name: Gibson Praise
Text: Place this Witness card in the Bureau. You may attach it at any time to an Agent in that section. If any Team including that Agent successfully investigates a Site, you may ask 'Is your X-File's Result Abduction?' in addition to the Site question at no cost. Discard this card afterward.
Dialogue: "If they find me, they'll take me. I know it." - Gibson Praise

name: God's Blessing
Text: Place this card in the Field. Once during your turn as Directed player you may pay 2 [CP] to move the top card of your opponent's Bureau deck into their Discard Pile. Your opponent may pay 7 [RP] to force you to discard this card.
Dialogue: "We're doing God's work, Diana. Without this immunity, everyone would die. This knowledge is God's blessing." - The Cigarette Smoking Man

name: Government Watchlist
Text: Play this card to your opponent's Field with three tokens on it. While in play, your opponent must keep all [CP] cost cards in their hand face up on the table. Remove one token during each Briefing phase of any attached Agent. When the last token is removed, discard this card.
Dialogue: "Names of people the federal government is tracking using the US census." - Skinner

name: Hand Bind
Text: Play this card during a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round on any Adversary with the Keyword PRIMORDIAL or that is capable of using MARTIAL ARTS cards. The Adversary may bind an Agent (your choice), preventing that Agent from dealing damage during the remaining CRC rounds.
Dialogue: "Go back to hell!" - Scully

name: Handheld Digital Recorder
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill.
Dialogue: "Okay. 6:01 p.m., February 24. Agents Scully and Mulder in the former home of David and Nancy Kline who disappeared without a trace last July." - Scully

name: Haunting Trickery
Text: Flip the top card of your Bureau deck (flip enough cards until getting a card with a cost number). Use that number as a negative skill modifier on target Agent's skill (your choice) until end of turn. The chosen skill cannot decrease below zero. Shuffle the Drawn cards into the Bureau deck afterwards.
Dialogue: Lyda "You look like you saw a ghost. There are ghosts in this house, you know…"

name: Head Calusari
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword PRIMORDIAL or OCCULT INVESTIGATION card is played.
Dialogue: "The evil that is here has always been. It has gone by different names through history - Cain, Lucifer, Hitler. It does not care if it kills one boy or a million men. If you try to stop us, the blood will be on your hands." - Head Calusari

name: Head X-Ray Plate
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's MEDICAL skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill.
Dialogue: "It looks like a computer chip." - Scully

name: Healing Regurgitation
Text: Play this card to recover an Agent that was killed and removed from play, where X is the cost of that Agent. Remove this card from the game. Each player may have only one of this card in their deck.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "The doctor says Mrs. Hangemuhl's kidneys have spontaneously healed. She's a healthy woman." - Doggett

name: Henry Weems
Text: Apply a +3 modifier to any one skill check made by a Team of Agents in the Field during the Investigation phase.
Dialogue: "What if he got really, really lucky? That's your big scientific explanation, Scully?" - Mulder

name: Hidden Twin-Barrell
Text: Play this card on any combatant to increase or decrease that Combatant's LRC by two points during that round.
Dialogue: "It's open. Can I help you?" - Geraldine

name: High Focus Camera
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's OBSERVATION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's BEHAVIORAL skill.
Dialogue: "I thought we might at least allow ourselves to reminisce." - Cigarette Smoking Man

name: Hog Hideout Hazard
Text: Force an opposing Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail, choose one Agent to go to the Hospital (undamaged).
Dialogue: "Is there some secret farmer trick to get these things moving?" - Mulder

name: Hollins, Roanoke County, VA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the MOTIVE is "Control", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.
Dialogue: Scully: "This isn't an X-File?"Mulder: "Call it what you like. Here in Roanoke they're calling it a demon baby snatching."

name: Home Call
Text: Search through your Bureau deck for any one Site card with Keyword RESULT. Show the card to your opponent and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: "I'm Assistant Director Walter Skinner with the FBI. May we come in?." - Skinner

name: Hope vs Selfishness
Text: Pay X [CP] to remove X [RP] from your opponent's pool immediately, or vice versa.
Dialogue: "Find Agent Scully. Only then will you realize the scope and grandeur of the project. Go. Go now!" - Well-manicured Man

name: Hostages
Text: Play after an Adversary card has been successfully played on a Site. Discard a card from your hand to add X [CP] to your pool. X = Half the cost of the Adversary played (rounded down).
Dialogue: "I just want to say that I believe you." - Kimberley

name: I Want To Believe
Text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: Scully: "Oh! This came for you."Mulder: "Thank you."

name: Identity Intrusion
Text: Play this card to gain control of an Agent during a single Combat round (your choice).
Dialogue: Scully: "What does that mean?"Mulder: "It means... It means whatever you want it to mean. Good night."

name: Identity Swap
Text: Play this card at the beginning of the Briefing Phase. Swap one of your Agents with an opponent's Agent of equal or lower cost in the same section (include tokens and attached cards). Players may not control duplicate Agents, and the Game Effect of the swapped Agents cannot be used. At the end of the turn, return both Agents to their final locations (sections).
Dialogue: Mulder: "Scully! He's not me!"

name: In Deep Shadows
Text: Play this card to negate search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: 'The End', 'Second's Elder Deliberation', 'Covering Up Evidence', or 'The Toothpick Man'. If you play the chosen card immediately, you may do so at half cost (rounded up). Alternatively, you can use this card to negate the effect of William.
Dialogue: "Your son has to die." - Robert Comer

name: In the Big Inning
Text: Play this card immediately after a Team of Agents has successfully investigated a Site and asked a Characteristic question regarding your X-File. If the question is answered with "yes", add 3 tokens to your [RP] pool.
Dialogue: "…what you may find is you concentrate on hitting that little ball… The rest of the world just fades away-- all your everyday, nagging concerns." - Mulder

name: Inexplicable Mind Vibes
Text: Move one Agent with the Keyword BELIEVER (your choice) to the Hospital immediately (undamaged). The Agent may not contribute to any skill checks this turn.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "They are coming." - Mulder

name: Inova Fairfax Medical Campus, Falls Church, VA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "She's not gone. Not her soul." - A. Pauley

name: Ivory Coast, West Africa
Question: You may ask one METHOD question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "I, too, am a professor of biology at the university but, uh, hardly one qualified to say what must have gone on here." - Amina Ngebe

name: Janke Dacyshyn
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. Dacyshyn engages one opposing Agent (your choice) in Combat. If Dacyshyn reduces the Agent to zero HEALTH, place this card on top of the Agent along with 3 tokens. Remove one token during each Briefing Phase. When no tokens are on the Agent, move the Agent to the Hospital including the damage tokens. This card is considered an ABDUCTION card.
Dialogue: "I'm transporting vital organ." - Janke Dacyshyn

name: Jesse Landis
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. If played after Adversary card "2Shy" attacked a Team, the cost of this card is halved.
Dialogue: "I smelled her perfume. That's when I knew he was lying. She was wearing her perfume when she left for her class." - Jesse

name: Jinn's Twisted Wish
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Place this card face up in your opponent's Bureau deck and reshuffle the deck. When this card reaches the top of the deck, your opponent's turn as Active player ends immediately. This card has no effect if it reaches the top of the deck during your opponent's turn as Directed player.
Dialogue: "I wish for peace on earth." - Mulder

name: John Lee Roche
Text: Adds 2 to one Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. Your opponent may pay 3 [CP] to negate this Witness.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Gregory Fremaux
Dialogue: "You choose the one that was your sister, and I'll tell you where she is. Hey, come on, it's a fifty-fifty chance." - John Lee Roche

name: Jorge Concepción
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OBSERVATION card played
Dialogue: "¡Por favor, no me lastime! ¡Yo tengo mucho miedo!" - Jorge

name: Josepho's Prophecy
Text: Play this card on a Site. For each card in your hand with the Keyword ALIEN, ALIEN INVESTIGATION, or BEHAVIORAL that you reveal to your opponent, increase the Site's Pre-requisite by 1.
Dialogue: "You want to see your son? You come alone and you follow my instructions to the letter." - Josepho

name: Kallencheck's Salvage Brokers, San Francisco, CA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "Actually I'd rather know who sold you the secret." - Mulder

name: Karin's Dark Sorcery
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. For each Agent that Karin's Dark Sorcery sends to the Hospital you may remove up to 4 [RP] from your opponent's Resource Pool.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Make him stop, Karin!  Tell him what you should have told him twenty years ago. You're not going to take it anymore."

name: Kill Switch
Text: The Kill Switch creates a distorted reality on the Team of Agents, dealing a total of 5 damage points, split among any number of opposing Agents (Directed Player's choice). For each chosen Agent, subtract their COMPUTER skill from the assigned damage - damage cannot be reduced below 0.
Dialogue: "What's that smell? Oh, jeez!" - Mulder

name: Knowle Rohrer
Text: Knowle Rohrer regenerates (heals) one point of HEALTH at the beginning of each combat round as long as his HEALTH is not at zero.
Dialogue: "Shoot me, Agent Doggett, if you think it'll make a difference this time." - Knowle Rohrer

name: Kroner, Kansas
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Well, this is not without historical precedent. The Old West was full of traveling men who claimed to be rainmakers. The Pueblo Indians even had a rain dance.." - Mulder

name: Krycek's Amputation
Text: Play on Agent Krycek when he is in the Field and is involved in an ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY skill check. Krycek loses his right arm and all his skills are halved (rounded up). This card cannot be negated and remains attached to Krycek until the end of the game.
Dialogue: "I'm sorry…Nyet! I am American…and I've been falsely accused of spying." - Alex Krycek

name: Krycek's Deadly Ultimatum
Text: Play this card to force any opponent to skip the Healing phase.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "I have a vial that contains a vaccine. Mulder knows of it. His father developed it to fight the alien virus." - Krycek

name: Langly
Text: Negate any one Bluff card.
Dialogue: Langly: "Check it out, Mulder. I had breakfast with the guy that shot John F. Kennedy".Mulder: "Is that so?"Langly: "Old dude, but yeah, said that he was dressed as a cop on the grassy knoll."

name: Lasioderma Serricorne Outbreak
Text: This card does not initiate Combat. Place target Agent under this card. The Agent may not contribute to any skill check this turn nor generate RES while under this card. At the beginning of your opponent's next Healing phase, remove this card from the game and send the Agent to the Hospital with two damage tokens.
Dialogue: Scully: "...it could be some form of contagious agent, like an insect-borne bacterium..."

name: Last Dial Inquiry
Text: Discard a card from your hand. During your next Briefing Phase, draw two additional cards (in addition to the one you would normally draw). Ignore the effects of any card that prevents you from doing so.
Dialogue: "I need to know the last call made from this booth." - Mulder

name: Letter From Samantha
Text: Play this card on a Team of Agents. If the Team makes an ALIEN INVESTIGATION Skill check 5+, look through any player's Bureau deck and remove any one card from the game. Shuffle that Bureau deck afterwards. You may only have one of this card in your Bureau Deck.
Dialogue: "Your sis… Samantha left this at the house for you."

name: Lieutenant Kraskow
Game Effect: Treat Lieutenant Kraskow's LRC skill as 4 if the number of agents in his Team is 4 or more.
Bio: Lieutenant Kraskow is a SWAT team leader managing the crime scene during a bank robbery. He collaborates with FBI Agent Skinner, who is seeking his trapped agents, Mulder and Scully.

name: Life From Ashes
Text: Play this card to heal all damage done to an Agent only if their HEALTH is reduced to zero after a Combat. The Agent can still contribute with their skills to the Site skill check this turn.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "I want you to rise. Rise up and heal!" - Samuel

name: Limited Choices
Text: Play this card to cause the Investigating player to discard X number of cards (chosen randomly) from his hand. X = [CP] cost paid.
Dialogue: "No one believes me. I'm an annoyance to my superiors, a joke to my peers. They call me Spooky. Spooky Mulder." - Mulder

name: Linda Bowman
Text: Play on a Team of three or more Agents investigating a Site. Only Agents with at least one of the skills listed in that Site prerequisite may participate in any skill check or Combat at this Site.
Dialogue: "After what they've done, do you think I'd let them get away with this? I'm gonna finish what you started." - Linda Bowman

name: Lizzy Gill
Game Effect: Lizzy Gill allows you to choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during the Briefing Phase. Treat Lizzy Gill as RES 2 if she is in the same Team as Agent Scully. If so, Scully's HEALTH value is decreased by one.
Bio: Lizzy Gill was introduced by Margaret Scully to assist during Scully's pregnancy. Later revealed as a scientist working for a faction interested in Scully's baby's genome. Despite suspicion, her actions imply Scully's baby is a natural miracle.

name: Lone No More
Text: Negate one of these cards (your choice): 'Byers', 'Frohike', 'Langly', 'Call on us more often', 'No one so paranoid', 'Three words, one solution', 'The Lone Gunman', 'The Lone Gunmen' or 'Three of a kind'.
Dialogue: "They meant so much to me. I'm not sure if they really knew." - Scully

name: Long-Range Combat Training
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal and in addition has a +2 in LRC skill. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.
Dialogue: "Are we talking kung-fu movies, Mulder?" -Scully

name: Lord of the Flies
Text: At the beginning of each combat round, you may choose one Agent. That Agent is webbed and cannot attack or use abilities that round. If that Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0 by the end of the Combat, you may draw one extra card at the start of your next Briefing Phase.
Dialogue: "Your mouth, your tongue... there's something wrong with you." - Natalie Gordon

name: Lucky Keyword Unlock
Text: Play on one Team in the Field. If the Team makes a COMPUTER skill check 5+, then they may add 2 to any Site skill check. Discard this card after you have used the modifier.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Vegreville."Kurt Crawford: "We're in."

name: Lulu Pfeiffer
Text: This You may search your Bureau deck for the "Betty Templeton" Adversary card and play it immediately, ignoring Activator requirements. If you do, both Adversaries attack simultaneously (treat as one Combat). Double both cards' CRC and HEALTH, and skip the LONG RANGE COMBAT round.
Dialogue: "What are you doing here?" - Lulu Pfeiffer

name: Maitreya's Virtual Menace
Text: Maitreya may use MARTIAL ARTS Combat cards. The damage dealt by her on any Agent can be considered "virtual": the Agents' controller may remove 1 point of damage (1 token) from any Agent damaged by Maitreya for each 2 [RP]'s spent on that Agent. This action may prevent those Agents to be sent to the Hospital.
Dialogue: Scully: "She's input herself into the game. We have to download her."

name: Manhole Surprise
Text: Play this card to search your Bureau deck for a card with the BLUFF keyword. Reveal it to your opponent, then add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
Dialogue: "Oh, crap!" - Mulder

name: Manipulating the Flock
Text: Place this card next to a Site card as a Resource. The next card your opponent plays at this Site must be discarded with no effect after it is paid for, except for cards that negate this card or Combat cards. Then, discard this card. If no such card is played, this card remains in play until the Site is discarded.
Dialogue: "I'm telling you the truth. I only want to help these people." - Absalom

name: Marita Covarrubias
Game Effect: If Marita Covarrubias is in the same Team as Agent Alex Krycek, they both gain +1 to their cumulative ALIEN INVESTIGATION and SCIENCES skills, and -1 to their CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills.
Bio: Assistant to one of the Special Representatives of the of the UN Secretary General, Marita Covarrubias is a mysterious character with little know background who provided top secret information to Agent Fox Mulder, whilst working with The Cigarette-Smoking Man.

name: Marty Glenn
Text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this resource when all tokens have been discarded.
Dialogue: "It's not magic. It's your crappy cologne. Who's that with you?" - Marty Glenn

name: Masked Identity
Text: Play this card any time during a Combat on any Adversary. If the Adversary's HEALTH was not reduced to zero yet, you may allow that Adversary to end Combat and return the card to your hand, but you cannot play the Adversary again this turn.
Dialogue: "I like to say whoever God didn't get around to creating in his own image, it's our job to recreate in ours." - Doctor Kaplan

name: Melissa Riedal-Ephessian
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to OCCULT INVESTIGATION 3+.
Dialogue: "We have come together in this life, this time. Only to meet in passing." - Melissa Riedal-Ephesian

name: Messages From Beyond
Text: Play this card to draw four cards, then place any two cards from your hand on top of your Bureau deck or in your discard pile.
Dialogue: "Close your eyes and let them come to you. They will come to you if you're ready to see." - Harold Piller

name: Michael Lee Kritschgau
Game Effect: Place one token on Kritschgau. Discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add a keyword BUREAUCRACY Witness card to your hand. Show it to your opponent and shuffle the deck. Additionally, if he is on the same Team as Agent Mulder, change Mulder's Keyword BELIEVER to SKEPTIC.
Bio: Michael Kritschgau was an employee of the Department of Defense. He stole a core sample from an FBI lab and later revealed Mulder that UFO conspiracy was a cover-up for military experiments.

name: Michelle Fazekas
Text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's RES value during the Briefing Phase if that Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.
Dialogue: "They appear to be human, but whoever left these uses the balls of his feet more like an animal." - Michelle Fazekas

name: Midnight Chase
Text: Play this card on any Agent to immediately skip one combat round for that Agent. The Agent takes no damage that round and may not deal any damage either.
Dialogue: "Well, whatever it is you do believe, Scully…when you walk into that room nothing sacred will hold." - Mulder

name: Midnight Inquisitor
Text: Discard this card to draw three cards from your Bureau deck during the requisition phase.
Dialogue: “Just give me my lotto ticket and, uh, a pint of malt scotch whiskey." - Clyde Bruckman

name: Mirage of Samantha
Text: Choose one effect: Add 5 tokens to your [CP] pool or target player discards two cards at random from his hand.
Dialogue: "I think people are looking hard for miracles… so hard that maybe they make themselves see what they want to see." - Mulder

name: Momentary Connection
Text: Play this card on a Team including Agent Fox Mulder and Agent Dana Scully. Choose one of these Agents to use one of the other Agent's skills during a single skill check decreased by one (i.e. Scully could use Mulder's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill as 3). You can only have one of this card in your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: "Ow! Something stung me." - Scully
