name: Mothman's Lair
Text: The Mothman is negated if the Team it attacks makes a successful SUBTERFUGE +4 skill check. The LRC round is skipped. For the first round of CRC, the chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. The Mothman may use SUBTERFUGE cards.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Witnesses described them as primitive looking men with red piercing eyes. Became known as the "moth men." I've got an X-File dating back to 1952 on it."

name: Mount Weather Complex, Bluemont, VA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question. Prerequisites of this card may not be changed by any card.
Dialogue: "Would you defend a man who believes in aliens against the FBI and the military? " - Mulder

name: Never Again
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in a Team investigating a Site to decrease all Agent's skills by one (LRC, CRC and HEALTH are not decreased). The final values cannot be negative. Discard this card when the Agent visits the Hospital.
Dialogue: "Never say never. Yeah, sometimes I wish I were that impulsive." - Scully

name: No One So Paranoid
Text: Play this card to gain one of the following: Adds +1 to Computer skill, negates one Event, or discard one Bluff card from a site.
Dialogue: Byers: "Both of you relax!"Langly: "Shut up, ya narc!"Frohike: "It's your fault we're here."

name: Norristown, Pennsylvania
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "Roche drove a white El Camino, Scully. I saw it in my dream…" - Mulder

name: Nothing Important Happened Today
Text: Play this card to lower a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION Site Prerequisite by 2.
Dialogue: "Grab them Monica, we've got less than a minute to get out of here." - Agent Doggett

name: Officer Keith Wetzel
Text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill once per turn while the Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.
Dialogue: "We came on this case looking for a werewolf, right?" - Mulder

name: Ofthalmoscope
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's MEDICAL skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's SCIENCES skill.
Dialogue: "I'm going to give you a tetanus booster just as a precaution."- Doctor Zenzola

name: One Breath
Text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and add any one Event card to your hand. Show your opponent which card you have added. Shuffle your deck.
Dialogue: "For me, life went at a proper pace. There were many rewards… until the moment that I knew, I… understood that… that I would never see you again… my little girl. Then my life felt as if it had been the length of one breath, one heartbeat." - William Scully

name: Opening Fire
Text: Play on any combatant during one LRC round. That combatant will deal damage to their opponents first. If the HEALTH value of any opponent reaches zero after applying modifiers or healing cards, that combatant is sent to the Hospital and cannot deal any damage back that round.
Dialogue: Mulder: "You murdered my father, you killed Scully's sister, and if Scully dies, I will kill you."

name: Otoscope
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's OBSERVATION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill.
Dialogue: Scully: "Look, I have no idea what killed this woman but I have to assume it's communicable."

name: Pam
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to BEHAVIORAL 3+
Dialogue: "Usually, you walk right by. You'll pass a few minutes earlier a few minutes later-- little details, they change. But it always ends the same." - Pam

name: Paralyzing Terror
Text: If the Team successfully investigates this Site, the Investigation phase ends immediately. Any other Site cards in play without Bluff cards attached must be discarded.
Dialogue: "Relax! Stop struggling! Stop it!" - Skinner

name: Patti Rich
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "They were real close when Bobby was little. Always kidding around and stuff. But Bobby sort of got into that teenage stage. He doesn't want to listen to nobody." - Patti Rich

name: Persuasive Push
Text: Play to prevent two Agents assigned to a Site from contributing their skills to one skill check (your choice) made by the Team this turn.
Dialogue: "All right, where's my next bread crumb?" - Mulder

name: Pheromone Bio-Sensor
Text: Agents equipped with a Pheromone Bio-sensor may discard it to increase the cost of all Adversary cards played in a Site investigated by their Team by 2. This card must be discarded before the Adversary cards are played.
Dialogue: Dr. Bronzino: "I'm getting a reading here. Trace levels inside the house…"

name: Phil's Diner
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
Dialogue: "The town was founded back in the 20s when some of Barnum and Bailey's troops started coming down here during the winter off-season." - Hamilton

name: Pinker Rawls
Text: LONG RANGE COMBAT attacks cause only half damage (rounded up) to Pinker Rawls.
Dialogue: "Trevor what?" - Pinker Rawls

name: Pittsfield, VI
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: Scully: "What'd you expect them to find, Mulder?"Mulder: "I don't know. A vortex, like the one in Oregon. Gravitational aberrations, unique chemical compositions, uh, relics that would indicate that the cave was a sacred site."

name: Piękny Umysł
Text: Zagraj te karte aby zobaczyc 3 karty z gory swojej talii Biura. Nastepnie mozesz umiescic je z powrotem w dowolnej kolejnosci.
Dialogue: "Skad wiesz co zamierza zrobic twoj przeciwnik? Dostajesz sie do jego glowy, czytasz jego mysli." - Mulder

name: Portable Radio
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Field. Discard this card when that Agent is investigating a Site and is forced to go back to the Bureau to allow that Agent to contribute their skills to any skill check made by their Team this turn.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Can I borrow your radio Mr. Sachs?"

name: Precision Sniper Riffle
Text: Adds three to the Agent's LONG RANGE COMBAT skill once per combat.
Dialogue: "Checkmate." - Gibson Praise

name: Premonitory Nightmare
Text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase. Place the card in the Field. During the Site investigation phase you may discard this card to add 2 to a Site skill check on any Team containing an Agent with the Keyword BELIEVER. Remove the card in any case at the end of your turn.
Dialogue: "You're saying that you're out here because of something you saw in a dream?" - Scully

name: Psychotic Episodes
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Field to lower the Agent's skill levels by one for each additional Agent in their Team. This change includes LRC, CRC, RES, and HEALTH. The final values cannot be negative. Discard this card if the Agent visits the Hospital.
Dialogue: "Mulder, this is not reality. This is a hallucination. It has to be. And either I am having it, or you are having it or we are having it together." - Scully

name: Quick Strike
Text: Play on any combatant during one CRC round. That combatant will deal damage to their opponents first. If the HEALTH value of any opponent reaches zero after applying modifiers or healing cards, that combatant is sent to the Hospital and cannot deal any damage back that round.
Dialogue: "Don't telegraph that left, Dre. Stevie Wonder would see that one coming. You're fighting the FBI now, Dre. Fight smart. Go!" - Skinner's coach

name: Ray Pearce, Metal Fury
Text: LONG RANGE COMBAT attacks cause only half damage (rounded up) to Ray Pearce.
Dialogue: "I've reviewed Ray's medical records from the VA. What his wife was calling Gulf War Syndrome is nothing of the kind. His entire cellular makeup was affected by exposure to some non-identifiable contaminant-- a metal." - Scully

name: Renewed Threat
Text: Play this card at the end of a Combat round on any Adversary card you control to return that Adversary card back to your hand only if the Adversary has not been defeated yet at the end of that round. You can play the Adversary card again (usual rules and cost).
Dialogue: Mulder: "If Modell makes it through surgery, I want to be the first person that he talks to."

name: Resist or Serve
Text: Force an opponent Team investigating a Site to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately.
Dialogue: "Talk to me, Scully! Sculllllllyyyyy! Dammit! Scully! Scully! Scully! Scully!" - Mulder

name: Restricted Access Notice
Text: Play this card to force an opponent Team currently investigating a Site to make an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check. If they fail only Agents with the Keyword FBI may contribute their skills to any skill check made on this Site.
Dialogue: "As of an hour ago, they pumped concrete into the cave. Sealed it for precautionary reasons." - Mulder

name: Revitalizing Rest
Text: During the Briefing Phase, place one token on one Agent you control that normally starts with at least one token. This token is usable in the same way that starting tokens can be used. Remove this card from play.
Dialogue: "Mulder: I thought you said you were on vacation. Scully: "I am. I'm up in Maine."

name: Rigged Lottery
Text: Play this card to examine your opponent's hand and force that player to discard X cards (your choice).
Dialogue: "They're all the same! This game is fixed." - Glen Chao

name: Road Map
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Field. Discard this card to return a Site card already investigated to your hand instead of discarding it.
Dialogue: Skinner: "What is it?"Scully: "Santa Claus."Mulder: "What?"Scully: "Stop. Turn around."

name: Rob Roberts, the Voracious Predator
Text: At the start of each Combat round, choose one Agent and reduce their HEALTH by 2. If that Agent is reduced to zero HEALTH during this round, Rob Roberts recovers 2 HEALTH, as long as his own HEALTH is greater than zero at the end of the round.
Dialogue: "What look like tool marks to you look to me like something more organic. Like it was made by a... a tongue or a proboscis." - Scully

name: Ronnie Strickland
Text: Only Agents with the Keyword BELIEVER may cause damage to Ronnie Strickland. If at any time during the Combat the Team attacked by Ronnie Strickland contains no Agents with the Keyword BELIEVER,the Combat ends immediately.
Dialogue: "Oh, man! What'd you have to go and do that for? You are in big trouble." - Ronnie Strickland

name: Route 320-A, Craiger, Maryland
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "This place isn't even on the map. How'd you get here?" - Skinner

name: SAC Darius Michaud
Game Effect: Any time during the Game you can sacrifice SAC Darius Michaud. Remove the card from the Game. If so, you may ask any one Characteristic question regarding one opponent's X-File.
Bio: Special Agent in Charge Darius Michaud played a significant role in the investigation of the mysterious bombing of a Federal Building in Dallas, Texas. He sacrificed himself in the building while searching for the bomb, demonstrating his dedication to duty and the safety of others.

name: SAC Fossa
Game Effect: Treat SAC Fossa as a RES 2 if she is in the Bureau. If Fossa is in the same Team as Agent Mosley Drummy and/or ASAC Dakota Whitney, she gains +1 to her COMPUTER and SCIENCES skills.
Bio: Special Agent in Charge Fossa was a senior member of the FBI. She was part of an FBI team that consecutively searched for missing Agent Monica Bannan and then Cheryl Cunningham.

name: Sacrificing Blast
Text: Place this card on any opponent's Field with two tokens on it. Each time this opponent plays a [RP] card, they must discard one card from their hand (opponent's choice). Remove a token during your opponent's Briefing Phase. When all tokens have been removed, discard this card.
Dialogue: Scully: "Mulder, get in the car, there's no time!"

name: Samantha's Diary
Text: Discard Samantha's Diary to return one card from your hand to the Bureau deck, then shuffle the deck. At the beginning of your next Briefing Phase, you may draw two additional cards. This draw effect cannot be negated.
Dialogue: Scully: "It's a diary. It's your sister's."

name: San Diego County Hospital, CA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: Scully: "Do you think I don't want what's best for this child? Do you think that I'm not trying to save her life?"

name: Sangradura, Mexico
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION, one MOTIVE, or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Hey, guard! Come here! Andale! Hey, guard! Somebody come here!" - Doggett

name: Santa Monica Peer, Los Angeles, CA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE, one METHOD or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Bosco's passes with the cups and balls. Wah-day… Chubio… Colerader. Three gone… And yet, three return." - Maleeni

name: Satellite Navigator
Text: Place 2 tokens on this card. Discard a token to look through your Bureau deck to draw any Site that asks a MOTIVE or METHOD question. Add it to your hand and reshuffle your Bureau deck. When no tokens remain, move this card to the Discard Pile.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I'm going to get you out of there."

name: Schlugg's Cult
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in a Team. Place five tokens on this card (three if the Team has any Agent with MEDICAL skill). The Agent must remain in the Field and cannot contribute to any Skill check until all tokens have been removed. Remove one token during each Active player's Debriefing Phase. Discard this card when the last token is removed. The Agent remains in the Field. Schlugg's Cult does not initiate Combat.
Dialogue: "No! Ahhh!!! You son of a bitch!" - Scully

name: Scripted Fate
Text: Write down the question you think your opponent will ask if successfully investigates this Site. Place this card on your opponent's Field with the paper underneath. If your opponent asks that question, you are not forced to answer it. Otherwise, add 2 [CP] to your [CP] pool. Discard this card afterwards.
Dialogue: Scully: "How is it you think you know me so well, Mr. Padgett?" Phillip Padgett: "I'm writing about you."

name: Scuba Suit
Text: Once per turn, the Scuba Suit adds 2 to the Agent's OBSERVATION or SUBTERFUGE skills during any skill check on any Site card related to a coastal state or country, or mentioning the words: 'Lake', 'River' or 'Sea'.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Once, I, uh... I got a quarter off of the deep end at the "Y" pool."

name: Scully's Cancer
Text: Play this card to force Agent Dana Scully's Team to make a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check. If they fail, move Scully to the Hospital immediately with zero HEALTH. Scully's recovery rate will be 1 damage token per turn. Attach this card to Scully as a reminder until she is fully healed.
Dialogue: "… matching the DNA from this virus with that which I believe has caused my cancer." - Scully

name: Scully's Dream
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "To fit in with her brothers, Dana also shot a snake." - Margaret Scully

name: Second Chance Memories
Text: Play this card during the Investigation Phase. If a Team of Agents you control fails the Site prerequisite skill check, you may recover up to two cards played on that Site from your Discard Pile (your choice), including Combat cards, but you cannot play them again this turn.
Dialogue: "The Smoking Man's dead." - Skinner

name: First Move
Text: Play this card during the Investigation phase (before any Combat has taken place) to search your Bureau deck for any one card with the keyword COMBAT. Reveal the card to your opponent, then add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck. If the card is playable this turn, you may play it at zero cost.
Dialogue: "You're free to go, of course. The choice is still yours." - The Cigarette-Smoking Man

name: Sect Leader Anthony Tipet
Text: You may play this card in its normal way, or use it to immediately end combat and control one Agent (your choice). Move the Agent to any section of the table. The Agent must remain in that section. Attach this card to the chosen Agent as a reminder. Discard this card during your opponent's next Investigation phase.
Dialogue: "If we have the courage to see into darkness we see into God... free of the clay which confines us." - Anthony Tipet

name: Section Chief Scott Blevins Assassinated
Text: If your opponent uses Agent Blevins as RES 2, while being in the Bureau during the Briefing Phase, Agent Blevins is instantly killed and removed from the game.
Dialogue: "Blevins had been on payroll for four years to a biotechnology company called Roush, which is somehow connected to all this." - Skinner

name: Security Pass
Text: Discard this card to change the Site Prerequisite to ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY in a Site investigated by the Agent equipped with this card. Keywords of the Site card are also changed
Dialogue: Security Guard: "Proceed down the hallway, please."

name: Senior Director Carter
Game Effect: Place one token on Director Carter. Discard a token to remove one Agent from any Team you control and send them to the Bureau. If in combat, the Agent takes no damage and contributes no skills.
Bio: Senior Director Carter is a high-ranking FBI official who interrogates Agent Dana Scully in Skinner's office regarding Agent Mulder's erratic behavior. He represents the bureaucratic concerns of the FBI as Mulder's investigations draw increasing scrutiny and institutional pressure.

name: Serpent Siege
Text: Play this card on any PRIMORDIAL Adversary. One of that Adversary's opponents (your choice) is paralyzed and will deal no damage during the next round of Combat.
Dialogue: "Help!" - Mulder

name: Shadowed Dealings
Text: The printed cost of any Bluff played at this Site is halved (rounded up).
Dialogue: "Tell him what he wants to hear." - The Cigarette-Smoking Man

name: Shared Secrets
Text: Play this card any time after Diana Fowley's successfully investigates a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill in the same Team as Agent Fox Mulder. Place 3 additional tokens on Mulder's card. Remove this card from the game.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "That's where it all begins. That's where we need to be if we want to survive it." - Mulder

name: Sheriff Lucius Hartwell
Text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill once per turn while the Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0. If played on Agent Dana Scully this card costs 1 [RP] less.
Dialogue: Hartwell: "You really know your stuff, Dana."

name: Shitstorming the X-Files
Text: Play this card to change the Site Prerequisite from CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION to SCIENCES.
Dialogue: "Get Out, Scully! This whole place could blow!" - Mulder

name: Sister Abigail
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword BEHAVIORAL or SUBTERFUGE card is played
Dialogue: "Please. I'm Sister Abby. This is Brother Oakley. We're all saddened by what has happened in your world, but it does not concern us." - Sister Abigail

name: Smoke Grenade
Text: Play this card on any combatant during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round to reduce the damage from all opponent sources by one point.
Dialogue: "Oh God, John, they're smoking us out. John, I need you here. I need you to focus here John." - Agent Reyes

name: Social Worker Contact
Text: Discard this card during the Investigation phase to search through your Discard Pile and add one Keyword RESOURCE card to your hand. Show the card to your opponents.
Dialogue: "I'd like to interview your son Charlie, Mr. Holvey, but with a professional counsellor." - Scully

name: Somerset, West Virginia, VA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION, one METHOD or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Keep it straight! Come on, straight." - Mosley Drummy

name: Specimen Vessels
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill.
Dialogue: "I think I located what you're looking for. It's a small miracle I found it, actually." - Dr. Kayser

name: Subliminal Assault
Text: Play this card on a Team of two or more Agents. Choose an Agent at random and attach this card to that Agent. The Agent engages in Combat against the rest of Agents on the Team. You control the Agent as an Adversary until the Combat ends. Discard this card afterwards.
Dialogue: "Mulder: Are you familiar with subliminal messages?"

name: Suicide Run
Text: Play this card on any Team of Agents at the end of any Combat round. If the Adversary you control is still alive, you may discard the Adversary to send to the Hospital any one Agent in the Team (your choice). That Agent is reduced to zero HEALTH.
Dialogue: "He's got a bomb. He's got a bomb. He's got a bomb. He's got a bomb. He's got a bomb..." - Mulder

name: Sussane Modeski
Text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's BUREAUCRACY skill once per turn while the Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.
Dialogue: "I'll prove it to you, just help me decipher this." - Susanne

name: T3 Connection, Fairfax County, Virginia
Game Effect: Bluffs played at this Site cost 1 additional [CP].
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
Dialogue: "Yeah, I've found something down in Fairfax County. A derelict chicken farm with a T3 connection, paid for by Aleph Industries, Palo Alto, of which there's no other record anywhere." - Mulder

name: Tandem Investigations
Text: Play this card when Agent Bill Patterson is about to use his Game Effect and only if Agent Nemhauser is in his same Team. Patterson's LRC and CRC skills are doubled during the Combat. Any opponents sent to the Hospital as a result of Patterson's LRC damage do not cause him any damage that round.
Dialogue: "He bit me! The son of a bitch bit me like a dog!" - Nemhauser

name: Telemedicine Tools
Text: Place this Equipment card in your Hospital section. During your Healing phase, you may place one Keyword MEDICAL or SCIENCES ACTIVE card under this card, face down. During your Investigation phase, you may play one of these cards for 2 [RP] less. No more than 2 cards may be under this card.
Dialogue: Doggett: "Help me out here, Agent Scully."

name: Tempus Fugit
Text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase to force any opponent to skip the next Healing, Requisition and Deployment phases and go directly to the Case Assignment phase. Remove this card from the game. The effects of this card may not be negated.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: Mike Millar: "You're saying the man sitting in seat thirteen-F was abducted mid-flight without any depressurization of the cabin, without any effect on the plane…"

name: The African Artifact
Text: Attach this card to an Agent with cost higher than three. Once you had successfully investigated a Site, you may remove this card and the Agent from play to ask an extra characteristic question regarding one opponent's X-File.
Dialogue: "A genuine artifact, one of several pieces of an unknown whole…" - Mulder

name: The Bat Thing
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. This card may be played in its normal way or on any Team that includes at least one Agent with the keyword SKEPTIC, ignoring Activator requirements. The Bat Thing may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.
Dialogue: "Today, he might have been fine but this thing hunts like a bat. It only attacks at night." - Ernie Stefaniuk

name: The Devil's Choice
Text: Discard the top card from both players' Bureau decks. If your card has higher cost than your opponent's, you may add 8 tokens to your [RP] pool (if you are the active player) or to the [CP] pool (if you are the Directed player). If lower, only empty your [RP] and [CP] pools, your opponent's pools remain unaffected. Then, shuffle both Bureau Decks.
Dialogue: "Is this what you saw? It's a Seraphim. An angel, with four faces. Those of a man, a lion, an eagle, and a bull." - Father McCue

name: The Elder's Call
Text: Put two tokens on this card. You can use a token to keep at your side a non-resource Witness card or a Site for an additional turn. Remove a token each time you use this ability. You can use both in the same turn. Remove this card from the game once all the tokens have been removed.
Dialogue: "Mister Mulder, I have someone here who'd like to speak with you." - First Elder

name: The End
Text: Play this card after answering "no" to a Characteristic Question regarding your X-File. Your opponent cannot ask about the same Characteristic for the next X turns, up to a maximum of three. X = [CP] cost paid.
Dialogue: "We entrusted you. You failed." - Well-Manicured Man

name: The Falls at Arcadia, San Diego County, CA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "So is this the American dream? This place?" - Scully

name: The Great Mutato
Text: Play this card during the Case Assignment phase and place it in the Field. Discard this card to negate one ADVERSARY card played by your opponent this turn (or discard it in any case at the end of the Investigation Phase).
Dialogue: "The experiments he attempted were too advanced for his understanding. The results of his experiments – unsatisfactory." - The Great Mutato

name: The Grey-Haired Man
Text: Reduce each Agent's LRC to 1. If target Team has more than one Agent, Your opponent may select one of those Agents not to participate in the Combat. If no Agent is chosen, then an additional LRC round will be played until your opponent selects an Agent to skip the Combat.
Created By: Greg Fremaux, Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel
Dialogue: "I've suffered some very personal... losses recently, and... I was... I was hoping…" - Mulder

name: The Lone Gunman
Text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and draw one Keyword ACTIVE card that increases an Agent or Team skill check during the Investigation phase. Add the card to your hand and reveal it to your opponent. Shuffle your deck.
Dialogue: "And began publishing a… what shall I call it… rag, called "The Lone Gunman."" - Morris

name: The Overcoat Woman
Text: Force your opponent to reveal their hand. Select one [CP] card. You may either play the selected card immediately (at its normal cost) or send it directly to its owner's Discard Pile. If played, the card is discarded afterwards.
Dialogue: "Yes, he is safe. We're here." - The Overcoat Woman

name: The Right Hand's Toll
Text: Pay 2 [CP] to move up to 3 [RP] from your opponent's [RP] pool to your [CP] pool immediately.
Dialogue: "Name's Nathaniel Teager. 26 confirmed solo enemy kills. A veritable killing machine. Left for dead by the same government that created him." - Denny Markham

name: The Siddhi Mystic's Curse
Text: Draw a number of cards from your Bureau deck equal to the number of Agents on target team. Use the cost value of each drawn card to assign damage to any Agent in that team (your choice) as separated LRC attacks. Draw enough cards until you have numerical values to assign the damage. Shuffle the deck (including the drawn cards.
Dialogue: "The Siddhi are a very mysterious and particularly powerful order of Fakirs." - C. Burks

name: The Toothpick Man
Text: Play this card to negate one Witness card played by your opponent. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: "He is not human." - Gibson Praise

name: The Truth
Text: Play this card after having successfully investigated a Site to ask an X-File's identity without incurring a penalty question. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: Byers: "Why risk perfect happiness, Mulder? Why risk your lives?"Mulder: "Because I need to know the truth."Byers: "You already know the truth."

name: The Twins Poisonous Attack
Text: This card does not initiate combat. The Team must make an OBSERVATION 5+ skill check. If unsuccessful, choose one Agent in the Team. That Agent receives 4 points of damage but can still contribute with his skills if HEALTH rating has not been reduced to 0. Healing cards can be played to avoid the damage, as usual.
Dialogue: "We didn't drink enough to make us sick." - Scully

name: The Walk
Text: Subtract one from all damage sources applied to this Adversary.
Dialogue: "I know a lot of crips have the same dream. The Walk. In my dream, I rise up, out of my chair, and I can stand. I look down the hallway, I'm not in the ward anymore, I'm home. With my baby girl." - Amputee

name: They are Watching
Text: Play this card to force your opponent to play with an open hand (all cards face up) until end of turn. If a card forces your opponent to discard any card randomly from their hand, you may choose them directly.
Dialogue: "Dr. Sandoz, I don't know if this is a secure line." - Scully

name: Third Elder's Deliberation
Text: During the Briefing Phase, remove one Game Effect token on any Agent that normally starts with at least one token. You may only have one of this card in your Bureau deck. Remove this card from play.
Dialogue: "Protection against what?" - Third Elder

name: Three of a Kind
Text: You may use this card to place up to six cards under it (face down) at any time. These cards cannot contain the Activator CONSPIRACY. You can play cards from here as if they were in your hand, with their cost increased by 1. Discard all cards if this card is negated. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.
Dialogue: "You know, Byers, growing old with us ain't so bad." - Langly

name: Three Words, One Solution
Text: Play this card to discard all [CP] tokens from your opponent's pool. The first card with [CP] cost played by your opponent may be played for free this turn.
Dialogue: "The cavalry just arrived"- Frohike

name: Time Rush
Text: Place this card in the Field. At the beginning of each player's Debriefing Phase, each player must draw one card from their Bureau Deck and then discard one card from their Bureau Deck. Afterwards, both players must reduce their hand to seven cards, as usual.
Dialogue: "Time acceleration is an equation, Mulder, a theory." - Scully

name: Too Close To The Truth
Text: Play this card to allow you to exchange [CP] Pools with your opponent.
Dialogue: "Your aliens, Agent Mulder. Your little green men arrived here millions of years ago." - Well-Manicured Man

name: Tossing Maneuver
Text: Negates the effects of any one Equipment card that adds to CLOSE RANGE COMBAT Skill for the duration of this combat.
Dialogue: "Knowle Rohrer? It can't be. I watched Knowle Rohrer die." - Doggett

name: Tracking the Killer
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "The deaths follow a pattern. New Jersey, New York, Scranton, and then an ad is placed here in Binghamton looking for a man exactly like the others. The killer is moving in a northerly direction." - Mulder

name: Tracking the Trail
Text: Put this card in your Bureau section. Add 1 [RP] to your [RP] pool for every Event card you play as Active player.
Dialogue: "They use this magnetic strip to track you, Whenever you go through a metal detector at an airport, they know exactly how much you're carrying." - Byers

name: Tricky Trick
Text: Play this card immediately after you have received a "yes" answer to the X-File Characteristic. You may take one [RP] card from your Discard Pile and add it to your hand.
Dialogue: "May I have complete silence, please?" - Maleeni

name: Trust Conflict
Text: Discard X cards from your hand to draw X cards from the top of your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: "Don't get me wrong. I love all music. But I prefer the stuff that lasts." - Mr. Burt

name: Trust_no1@mail.com
Text: Select one card with the Keyword CONSPIRACY from your Discard Pile and reveal it to your opponent. Place it in your hand. You cannot use the card this turn.
Dialogue: "If I see, or suspect that you're not working alone I will terminate our communication." - Shadow Man

name: Truthful Journey
Text: You may move up to two Agents from the Bureau Section to the Field immediately. This card may not be played once an Adversary has forced combat until after the combat is resolved. If two Agents are moved, they must join the same Team in the Field.
Dialogue: "Do you see anything at all?" - Doggett

name: Tunguska, Siberian Forest, Russia
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: Mulder: "June 30, 1908. Tungus tribesmen and Russian fur traders look up into the southeastern Siberian sky and see a fireball streaking to Earth. When it hit the atmosphere, it created a series of cataclysmic explosions that are considered to be the largest single cosmic event in the history of civilization. Two thousand times the force of the bomb that was dropped on Hiroshima."

name: Ultimate Deception
Text: Force an opposing Agent (your choice) to go to the Hospital immediately and may not contribute to the Site skill check. The Agent takes two points of damage and must be fully healed to leave the Hospital.
Dialogue: "Every minute of every day we choose. Who we are. Who we forgive. Who we defend and protect." - Skinner

name: Unclassified Reports
Text: Attach this card to any Agent and put three cards from your Discard Pile under it. Any time during the game, you may discard one of the cards to gain a +1 modifier on one of the Keywords listed on that card. Discard this card when no cards remain under it.
Dialogue: "That's your sister's file." - Scully

name: Undercovered Broadcast
Text: Put this card in your Bureau section. Add 1 [CP] to your [CP] pool for every Event card you play as Directed player.
Dialogue: "I've been thinking about this whole situation, y'know? And I think you're right. I think we won this one, I think we should just move on." - Mulder

name: Unearthly Exposure
Text: Place this card on any Agent in the Field investigating a Site with two tokens on it. The Agent is removed from play. Remove one token during each of the controlling player's Healing Phases. When no tokens remain, move the Agent to the Field.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: Prisoner: "I will die in an experiment when there is no longer any use for me." Mulder: "What kind of experiment?

name: Unearthly Harvest
Text: Play this card to exchange both pools ([RP] and [CP]) with your opponent.
Dialogue: "They're … they're taking her. They're … oh, my God." - Scully

name: Unexpected Hospital Visit
Text: Attach this card to any Agent with cost of 5 [RP] or less who is investigating this Site. Each time this Agent investigates any Site, you may pay that cost to force that Agent to go to the Hospital (undamaged). This card is removed when a Healing card is played on the Agent.
Dialogue: "He said I was the only one who'd believe him" – Diana Fowley

name: Unexpected Stroke
Text: Discard two cards from your hand (your choice) to apply a -2 modifier to any Agent's skill check on this Site.
Dialogue: Nurse: "Mr. Hosteen cannot accept any visitors at this time."

name: Unnatural Illusion
Text: Negate any one Keyword ALIEN, ALIEN MANIPULATION or ALIEN INVESTIGATION card.
Dialogue: "This is an interesting dream. Wake up. Come on, Artie." - Arthur Dales

name: Unstoppable Ally
Text: Play this card during a Close Range Combat round to search your Bureau Deck for any one card with the keyword COMBAT. Reveal the card to your opponent and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck. If the card is immediately playable, You may do so for zero cost.
Dialogue: "You didn't trust me." - Shannon McMahon

name: Unstoppable Pursuit
Text: Play this card during the Case Assignment phase to move one Agent in a Team assigned to a Site to another Team in the Field assigned to a different Site.
Dialogue: "Crump? Is this what happened to your wife? This same thing? If you stop moving, you die?" - Mulder

name: US Naval Station, San Diego
Question: You may ask one METHOD, one RESULT or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: Morgan: "What the hell is that?"Mulder: "Looks like the fuselage of a plane."

name: Van Allen's Revenge
Text: Once the Combat ends, you may pay 2 [CP] to return Van Allen's Revenge to your hand. It may be played again at the same Site. Your opponent may pay 3 [RP] to cancel this effect.
Dialogue: "Don't feel sorry. You going to hell just like I am, brother." - Ed Kelso

name: Vassily Peskow
Text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. This card cannot be played over Agent Alex Krycek. Vassily Peskow can use SUBTERFUGE cards.
Dialogue: "I am only here, Comrade, to congratulate you on a fine job." - Krycek

name: Vicki Burdick
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's OBSERVATION or adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.
Dialogue: "I've been running numbers here on the murder victims…and the strangest thing has come up." - Vicki Burdick

name: Virtual Training
Text: This card adds 2 points to an Agent's LRC or CRC skill (your choice) during the Combat.
Dialogue: Scully: "Where's Mulder?"Langly: "Mulder's in level one."

name: Visions of a Shaman
Text: Pick the top three cards of your Bureau deck. Use the cost of the first one for the Shaman's LRC skill, the cost of the second as CRC, and the last one as HEALTH value (draw additional cards if needed if the cost of any of those cards is not a specific number). Shuffle your Bureau afterwards (including the drawn cards).
Dialogue: "...there are powers that should not be disturbed... That some things are better left buried." - Mulder

name: Visions of Homicide
Text: Play this card to allow you to look the top five cards of your opponent's Bureau deck. You can perform this action at the beginning of your opponent's Briefing Phase.
Dialogue: "Oh my god. I'm taking her to the hospital." - Brian Tillman

name: Voodoo Ritual
Text: Play this card to decrease the cost of the first Adversary card you play in this Site by two.
Dialogue: "…they're called "poppets". Inside you place three thorns of a blood red rose, a strand of hair and a photo of your victim. - Proprietor

name: Voodoo Unleashed
Text: Play on one Team in the Field. If the Team makes an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check 5+, then they may add 2 to any Site skill check. Discard this card after you have used the Modifier.
Dialogue: "Au nom des saints… et de la lune. Au nom des saints et des étoiles." - Colonel Wharton

name: We Are Not Alone
Text: The next cards that you play on this site will have their cost increased by 1. Your opponents may not negate any of those cards this turn.
Dialogue: "I knew why my life had been spared. That I was to deliver the message of these angels. These sons of god." - Zeke Josepho

name: Weakening Grip
Text: Discard a card at random from your opponent's hand for each Agent investigating this Site.
Dialogue: "What does Rawls want? The money? $90,000 from the Bay Saint Louis robbery?" - Mulder

name: Wetwired
Text: Play on an Agent in a Team of 2 or more Agents. That Agent initiates Combat against another Agent in the Team (your choice). Follow usual Combat rules until any of the Agents' HEALTH is reduced to zero. The Combat ends and that Agent (or both) must go to the Hospital. The remaining Team may still contribute to the Site skill check as usual.
Dialogue: Langly: "This device is stimulating electrical activity in the brain."

name: Whanshang Dole
Text: Wanshang Dhole deals damage to its opponents first during each CRC round. If the HEALTH value of any opponent reaches zero after applying modifiers or healing cards,that combatant is sent to the Hospital and cannot deliver any damage back that round.
Dialogue: "Hey, Buck. What's wrong, Buck?" - Dr James Riley

name: Whispers of Hearts
Text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one BEHAVIORAL or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "She was strangled. He used an eight-gauge electrical cord. He took something from the body post-mortem… a trophy. A piece of fabric cut from her clothes… in the shape of a heart." - Mulder

name: William
Text: Apply a +2 modifier to any one skill check made by a Team of Agents in the Field during the Investigation phase.
Dialogue: "I am scared for you, Mulder. And for William. The forces against us are unrelenting." - Scully

name: Witch Hunter
Text: Search your Bureau deck and choose any one keyword OCCULT or OCCULT INVESTIGATION card. Show this card to your opponent, add it to your hand and shuffle your Bureau Deck.
Dialogue: "Last checked out to a Dave Duran." - Scully

name: Women's Health Clinic, Richville, MD
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "If Anything should happen to me, or if we become separated, you must meet me here: 1255 91st St. Richville, M.D." - Note to Fox Mulder from Samantha Mulder

name: X
Text: Negate any one Keyword ADVERSARY card.
Dialogue: "You failed. This is your success? Killing me? The truth is… you need me, Agent Mulder." - X

name: X's Final Struggle
Text: Place this card on your opponent's side. While this card is in play, your opponent cannot use cards nor Agent's Game Effects that allow them to draw cards (or search for cards) from the Bureau deck or from the Discard Pile. During your Briefing Phase pay 1 [CP] or discard this card.
Dialogue: "I was warned by a man we both know… who I believe knows the truth…" - Scully

name: Zelma's Palm Readings, North Minneapolis, MN
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
Dialogue: "The palms tell me all." - Madame Zelma
